// === Tab: mySketch ===
/*
  Cubic Limit: Katakana Kinetic (High-Speed Voice Edition)
  A generative tribute to Manfred Mohr (1972)
*/

// Complete Katakana syllabary array from 'A' to 'N'
var KATAKANA = [
  "ア", "イ", "ウ", "エ", "オ", "カ", "キ", "ク", "ケ", "コ",
  "サ", "シ", "ス", "セ", "ソ", "タ", "チ", "ツ", "テ", "ト",
  "ナ", "ニ", "ヌ", "ネ", "ノ", "ハ", "ヒ", "フ", "ヘ", "ホ",
  "マ", "ミ", "ム", "メ", "モ", "ヤ", "ユ", "ヨ", "ラ", "リ",
  "ル", "レ", "ロ", "ワ", "ヲ", "ン"
];

var rotators = []; // Array to store rotation speed and initial offset for each cube
var cols, rows;    // Variables for dynamic grid columns and rows
var interval;      // Numerical distance between grid cells
var marginX, marginY; // Margins used to center the grid on the canvas
var cubeSize;      // Diameter of the wireframe cube
var highlightIndex = -1; // Index of the character currently being vocalized
var highlightStartTime = 0; // Timestamp for the start of the highlight effect

function setup() {
  createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL); // Create a full-screen WEBGL canvas
  ortho(); // Use orthographic projection for a consistent geometric look

  // Initialize random rotation vectors for all 46 Katakana characters
  for (let i = 0; i < KATAKANA.length; i++) {
    rotators.push({
      speedX: random(-0.015, 0.015), // Random slow rotation velocity on X axis
      speedY: random(-0.015, 0.015), // Random slow rotation velocity on Y axis
      speedZ: random(-0.015, 0.015), // Random slow rotation velocity on Z axis
      offX: random(TWO_PI),         // Random initial rotation angle for X
      offY: random(TWO_PI),         // Random initial rotation angle for Y
      offZ: random(TWO_PI)          // Random initial rotation angle for Z
    });
  }
  
  calculateLayout(); // Perform the initial calculation of the responsive grid
}

function windowResized() {
  resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight); // Adjust canvas dimensions when window is resized
  calculateLayout(); // Recalculate grid centering and scaling for the new size
}

function calculateLayout() {
  const n = KATAKANA.length; // Reference the total count of 46 characters
  const aspect = width / height; // Determine the current screen aspect ratio
  cols = ceil(sqrt(n * aspect)); // Calculate the number of columns to fit the screen shape
  rows = ceil(n / cols);        // Calculate the number of rows based on the columns
  let cellW = width / (cols + 1); // Calculate maximum potential width per cell
  let cellH = height / (rows + 1); // Calculate maximum potential height per cell
  interval = min(cellW, cellH);   // Set interval to the smaller dimension to keep cells square
  cubeSize = interval * 0.55;    // Set cube size relative to the cell interval
  marginX = (width - (cols - 1) * interval) / 2; // Calculate horizontal margin to center grid
  marginY = (height - (rows - 1) * interval) / 2; // Calculate vertical margin to center grid
}

function draw() {
  background(0); // Clear the frame with a solid black background
  noFill(); // Disable filling to maintain wireframe aesthetics

  let nowTime = millis(); // Store current runtime in milliseconds

  // Trigger highlight and speech attempt every 2500ms (2.5 seconds)
  if (nowTime - highlightStartTime > 2500) {
    highlightIndex = floor(random(KATAKANA.length)); // Pick a random Katakana index
    highlightStartTime = nowTime; // Reset the highlight timer
    speakKatakana(KATAKANA[highlightIndex]); // Call function to vocalize the character
  }

  translate(-width / 2, -height / 2); // Shift WEBGL origin to top-left for grid logic

  drawBackgroundGrid(); // Draw the static reference grid in the background

  let idx = 0; // Iterator for the Katakana array index
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) { // Loop through each calculated row
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) { // Loop through each calculated column
      if (idx >= KATAKANA.length) break; // Exit loop if all characters are processed

      let rot = rotators[idx]; // Access specific rotation data for current index
      let px = marginX + c * interval; // Calculate X coordinate for this cell
      let py = marginY + r * interval; // Calculate Y coordinate for this cell

      // Highlight logic: Render in RED for exactly 2000ms (2 seconds)
      let isHighlighted = (idx === highlightIndex && (nowTime - highlightStartTime) < 2000);

      push(); // Save the current transformation state
      translate(px, py, 0); // Position the local coordinate system in the grid
      rotateX(rot.offX + frameCount * rot.speedX); // Apply dynamic rotation on X axis
      rotateY(rot.offY + frameCount * rot.speedY); // Apply dynamic rotation on Y axis
      rotateZ(rot.offZ + frameCount * rot.speedZ); // Apply dynamic rotation on Z axis

      stroke(isHighlighted ? color(150, 0, 0) : 100); // Set frame color to red or gray
      strokeWeight(1.5); // Use thin lines for the bounding cube
      box(cubeSize); // Render the 3D wireframe box

      stroke(isHighlighted ? color(255, 50, 50) : 255); // Set character color to red or white
      strokeWeight(max(1.5, interval * 0.025)); // Scale line thickness to cell size
      drawCleanKatakana(KATAKANA[idx], cubeSize); // Render the geometric Katakana
      pop(); // Restore the transformation state

      idx++; // Advance to the next Katakana character
    }
  }
}

// Function to invoke the Web Speech API in Japanese
function speakKatakana(text) {
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel(); // Stop any overlapping or previous speech tasks
  let utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text); // Create a new speech synthesis request
  utterance.lang = 'ja-JP'; // Set target language to Japanese
  utterance.rate = 0.9; // Adjust speech speed for clear articulation
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance); // Execute the voice output
}

function drawBackgroundGrid() {
  stroke(35); // Set a subtle dark color for the reference grid
  strokeWeight(1); // Set a standard line weight for the grid
  for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) { // Draw all vertical grid lines
    let x = marginX + c * interval; // Determine X position for the line
    line(x, 0, 0, x, height, 0); // Draw vertical line from top to bottom
  }
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) { // Draw all horizontal grid lines
    let y = marginY + r * interval; // Determine Y position for the line
    line(0, y, 0, width, y, 0); // Draw horizontal line from left to right
  }
}

// Geometric coordinate data for rendering Katakana characters as wireframes
function drawCleanKatakana(char, s) {
  let h = s / 2; let q = s / 4; let z = h; // Bounds (h), Quarter-points (q), and Depth (z)
  switch (char) { // Switch logic based on the specific character
    case "ア": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(h, -h, z, h, -q, z); line(h, -q, z, -h/2, h, z); break; // A
    case "イ": line(q, -h, z, -h, 0, z); line(q, -h, z, q, h, z); break; // I
    case "ウ": line(0, -h, z, 0, -q, z); line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(h, -q, z, -h, h, z); break; // U
    case "エ": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(0, -h, z, 0, h, z); line(-h, h, z, h, h, z); break; // E
    case "オ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(0, -h, z, 0, h, z); line(0, -q, z, -h, h, z); break; // O
    case "カ": line(-h, -q, z, q, -q, z); line(q, -q, z, q, h, z); line(0, -h, z, -h/2, h, z); break; // KA
    case "キ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(0, -h, z, 0, h, z); line(0, h, z, -h/2, h, z); break; // KI
    case "ク": line(h, -h, z, -h, -h, z); line(-h, -h, z, h, h, z); break; // KU
    case "ケ": line(-h, 0, z, h, 0, z); line(0, -h, z, -h, h, z); line(h/2, -h, 0, h/2, h, 0); break; // KE
    case "コ": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(h, -h, z, h, h, z); line(h, h, z, -h, h, z); break; // KO
    case "サ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-q, -h, z, -q, h, z); line(q, -h, 0, q, 0, 0); break; // SA
    case "シ": line(-h, -h, z, -q, -q, z); line(-h, 0, z, -q, q, z); line(-h, h, z, h, h, z); line(h, h, z, h, -h, z); break; // SHI
    case "ス": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(0, -h, z, -h, h, z); line(0, 0, z, h, h, z); break; // SU
    case "セ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(h, -q, z, h, h, z); line(-q, -h, z, -q, q, z); break; // SE
    case "ソ": line(-q, -h, z, -h, -h, z); line(h, -h, z, -h, h, z); break; // SO
    case "タ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(h, -q, z, -h, h, z); line(-h, q, z, 0, q, z); break; // TA
    case "チ": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h/2, z); line(-h, 0, z, h, 0, z); line(0, -h, z, -h, h, z); break; // CHI
    case "ツ": line(-h, -h, z, -q, -q, z); line(0, -h, z, q, -q, z); line(h, -h, z, -h, h, z); break; // TSU
    case "テ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(0, q, z, -h, h, z); break; // TE
    case "ト": line(0, -h, z, 0, h, z); line(0, 0, z, h, q, z); break; // TO
    case "ナ": line(-h, 0, z, h, 0, z); line(0, -h, z, -h, h, z); break; // NA
    case "ニ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); break; // NI
    case "ヌ": line(-h, -h, z, h, h, z); line(h, -h, z, -h, h, z); line(h, h, z, h, h-q, z); break; // NU
    case "ネ": line(0, -h, z, 0, h, z); line(-h, -h, z, 0, 0, z); line(0, 0, z, h, h, z); line(-h, q, 0, h, q, 0); break; // NE
    case "ノ": line(h, -h, z, -h, h, z); break; // NO
    case "ハ": line(-q, -h, z, -h, h, z); line(q, -h, z, h, h, z); break; // HA
    case "ヒ": line(-h, -h/2, z, -h, q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(h, q, z, h, -h/2, z); line(-h, 0, 0, h, 0, 0); break; // HI
    case "フ": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(h, -h, z, -h, h, z); break; // FU
    case "ヘ": line(-h, q, z, 0, -h, z); line(0, -h, z, h, q, z); break; // HE
    case "ホ": line(-q, -h/2, z, q, -h/2, z); line(0, -h, z, 0, h, z); line(-q, q, z, -h, h, z); line(q, q, z, h, h, z); break; // HO
    case "マ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(h, -q, z, h, q, z); break; // MA
    case "ミ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, 0, z, h, 0, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); break; // MI
    case "ム": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(h, -q, z, 0, h, z); line(0, h, z, -h, h, z); break; // MU
    case "メ": line(h, -h, z, -h, h, z); line(-h, -h, 0, 0, 0, 0); break; // ME
    case "モ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(0, -h, z, 0, h, z); break; // MO
    case "ヤ": line(-h, 0, z, h, 0, z); line(-h/2, -h, z, -h/2, h, z); line(h/2, -h, 0, h/2, 0, 0); break; // YA
    case "ユ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(-h, -q, z, -h, q, z); break; // YU
    case "ヨ": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(-h, 0, z, 0, 0, z); line(-h, h, z, h, h, z); line(-h, -h, z, -h, h, z); break; // YO
    case "ラ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(h, q, z, -h, h, z); break; // RA
    case "リ": line(-h/2, -h, z, -h/2, 0, z); line(h/2, -h, z, h/2, h, z); break; // RI
    case "ル": line(-h/2, -h, z, -h/2, h, z); line(h/2, -h, z, h/2, h, z); line(h/2, h, z, h, h, z); break; // RU
    case "レ": line(-h/2, -h, z, -h/2, h, z); line(-h/2, h, z, h, h, z); break; // RE
    case "ロ": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(h, -h, z, h, h, z); line(h, h, z, -h, h, z); line(-h, h, z, -h, -h, z); break; // RO
    case "ワ": line(-h, -h, z, h, -h, z); line(h, -h, z, h, h, z); line(-h, -h, z, -h, -q, z); break; // WA
    case "ヲ": line(-h, -q, z, h, -q, z); line(-h, q, z, h, q, z); line(q, -h, 0, -h, h, 0); break; // WO
    case "ン": line(-h, -h, z, -q, -q, z); line(-h, h, z, h, -h, z); break; // N
  }
}
